text.font-family: Instrument Serif, Times New Roman, Georgia, serif

g.text: links-tier only, never his own writing
Body copy sets over the ground, a prose link inside it.
Meta and captions sit dim. Nav is its own tone.
The tinted panel, not a bar or a rule.
Accent 2 marks the links tier only.
